datasets.name: AmodalAppleSize_RGB-D
datasets.image_count: 3925 Fuji RGB-D images; 2731 Elstar RGB-D images

ground_truth.calibration: RGB-D; inspect archive for camera parameters
ground_truth.physical: Fuji per-apple caliper diameters; Elstar tree/stage means

datasets.relabeling_strategy: Annotate visible unoccluded silhouettes at native resolution; retain physical fruit IDs separately. Never use amodal boundaries as observed edges.
datasets.redistribution_constraints: Attribution required; retain source citation and mark derivatives.
datasets.verification_scope: Public metadata and terms only; no archive contents or checksum verified.

datasets.name: Apple Fruitlet Sizing and Growth Rate Tracking

ground_truth.calibration: stereo calibration and rectified stereo images
ground_truth.edge: Mask R-CNN annotations; not subpixel GT

datasets.relabeling_strategy: Match cluster, fruit and day IDs; annotate visible boundaries independently of physical diameter.
datasets.verification_scope: Public metadata and terms only; no archive contents or checksum verified.

datasets.name: MVTec ITODD / BOP
datasets.image_count: 3500 scenes / 28 objects in original; BOP is a subset

ground_truth.calibration: multi-sensor calibration; verify selected BOP split
ground_truth.physical: CAD geometry; not independent as-built dimensional measurements
ground_truth.edge: pose-derived silhouettes are proxy GT; test poses may be withheld

datasets.relabeling_strategy: Start with real validation images; label exposed metal silhouettes and inspect pose/calibration uncertainty. Exclude train_pbr.
datasets.redistribution_constraints: Noncommercial only, attribution and share-alike; keep separate from unrestricted tracks.
datasets.verification_scope: Public metadata and terms only; no archive contents or checksum verified.

datasets.name: Weld bead images and masks
datasets.relabeling_strategy: Use masks to nominate strips; manually review ambiguous bead boundaries. Native resolution limits subpixel claims.
datasets.redistribution_constraints: Preserve MIT copyright/permission notices; verify accompanying archive notices.
datasets.verification_scope: Public metadata and terms only; no archive contents or checksum verified.

datasets.name: Weld bead images from the literature
datasets.relabeling_strategy: Inspect original sources in attribution spreadsheet; avoid rescaled paper figures for precision evaluation.
datasets.redistribution_constraints: Deposit states CC BY 4.0; underlying literature images need per-image rights review before redistribution.
datasets.verification_scope: Public metadata and terms only; no archive contents or checksum verified.

datasets.name: MovingCables
datasets.data_nature: real acquisition; source RGBA already chroma-key processed; standard release composited

ground_truth.edge: Marker-derived masks/flow; chroma-keyed source, not native subpixel edge truth

datasets.relabeling_strategy: Inspect RGB channels of source clips; ignore chroma-key alpha as precision GT. Exclude composed clips. Group by sequence and relabel visible cable edges.
datasets.redistribution_constraints: Dataset CC BY-SA 4.0; repository code MIT. Attribute and preserve share-alike on derivatives.
datasets.verification_scope: Public metadata and terms only; no archive contents or checksum verified.

datasets.name: VisA

ground_truth.edge: anomaly masks, not object edge GT

datasets.relabeling_strategy: Select object silhouettes and track boundaries; annotate new strips. Do not score anomaly masks as dimensional truth.
datasets.redistribution_constraints: Dataset CC BY 4.0; code Apache-2.0. Attribute and document relabeling.
datasets.verification_scope: Public metadata and terms only; no archive contents or checksum verified.

datasets.name: DeepPCB
datasets.resolution: 640 x 640 crops; original acquisition about 16k x 16k
datasets.data_nature: real acquisition with preprocessing and artificial defects

ground_truth.calibration: approx. 48 px/mm acquisition claim, not a calibration certificate

datasets.relabeling_strategy: Inspect retained grayscale content; prefer genuine unaffected boundaries. Artificially added defects must be tagged/excluded.
datasets.redistribution_constraints: README says research only although repository LICENSE is MIT; clarify dataset terms before reuse/redistribution.
datasets.verification_scope: Public metadata and terms only; no archive contents or checksum verified.

datasets.name: Wang et al. steel-plate subpixel dataset

ground_truth.edge: paper describes manual high-resolution labels and 4x downsampling

datasets.relabeling_strategy: If released, inspect original annotations and pixel-center transform; account for annotator error rather than treating divided coordinates as exact.
datasets.redistribution_constraints: Article access/license does not grant a dataset license. No usable public data download located in this review.
datasets.verification_scope: Public metadata and terms only; no archive contents or checksum verified.

datasets.name: Segmentation Masks of MIG/MAG Fillet Weld Joint Profile Images
datasets.data_nature: real VGA camera images with binary region masks

ground_truth.calibration: fixed camera setup described, no metric calibration supplied
ground_truth.edge: binary weld-region masks; only coarse boundary proxy

datasets.relabeling_strategy: Inspect native photos; draw reviewed visible transitions. Automatic top-of-mask crossings are low-confidence development-only proxy tasks.
datasets.redistribution_constraints: CC BY 4.0 attribution; cite Zenodo record and identify derived labels.
datasets.verification_scope: Publisher API metadata, license, 98 file sizes and MD5 hashes verified; local download adapter verifies each file. Mask semantics inspected on a small visual sample, not all boundaries adjudicated.
